description: group_log/backfill.rs defines F: Fn(LogEntryId) -> Fut. Taking LogEntryId by value means every call site must clone the ID before passing it to the closure (as seen in all three integration tests which explicitly clone). The callback should take &LogEntryId or LogEntryId should implement Copy (it wraps [u8; 32]). Since LogEntryId is already Clone + 32 bytes, implementing Copy is the cleanest fix; alternatively change the Fn bound to Fn(&LogEntryId) -> Fut.
notes: With LogEntryId now Copy (stoa-ftx6h.133), pass-by-value is zero-cost. Changing the callback to &LogEntryId introduces unsatisfiable lifetime constraints in async closures. Pass-by-value is correct here; no code change needed.
title: core: backfill fetch callback takes LogEntryId by value, forcing callers to clone
